items.question: How did Kitija Laksa reach the WNBA?
items.answer: Kitija Laksa made her WNBA debut with the Phoenix Mercury on May 21, 2025, five years after the Seattle Storm drafted her 11th overall. She played 33 games for Phoenix in 2025 and signed with the Dallas Wings in August 2026.

items.question: What are Kitija Laksa's WNBA career averages?
items.answer: Kitija Laksa has averaged 5.6 points and 1.3 rebounds in 37 WNBA regular-season games. In 2025 with Phoenix, she averaged 5.9 points in 33 games.

items.question: Does Kitija Laksa play for Latvia?
items.answer: Yes. Kitija Laksa plays for Latvia's national team. She averaged 9.6 points at EuroBasket Women 2017 and 15.7 points at EuroBasket Women 2023.

items.question: How tall is Kitija Laksa?
items.answer: Full Court Buckets lists Kitija Laksa at 6 feet 1 inch. She plays guard.

items.question: Where did Kitija Laksa play college basketball?
items.answer: Kitija Laksa played at South Florida. A knee injury in November 2018 ended her senior season.
